candidateOccurrences.sourceText: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
